author: Carlos Martinez
title: iRacing IMSA Clips at Road Atlanta
description: Short iRacing clips from Road Atlanta in IMSA multiclass races. This is a racing simulator. See prototypes, Porsches and GT cars in the trees.

sections.p: This is iRacing, a racing simulator. It is not real life. All the clips below were recorded in the sim.
I recorded short clips at Road Atlanta. Most are IMSA multiclass, and a few are from a GT cockpit.

list: A blue prototype with a big rear wing passes close as the pack runs through the trees.
A red Porsche GT car stays right ahead for the whole 30 seconds.
A magenta Porsche leads a pack of GT cars past the Motul banner.
From a GT cockpit, a white car with the number 20 sits ahead after the pits, with a yellow-and-black car further up the road.
A pack runs ahead through the trees, and a Michelin Raceway Road Atlanta banner flashes past.
One lap goes past the Michelin banner and the grandstands with no other car in view.
Another lap passes the Motul and Michelin banners with a white car in the mirror.

sections.p: Road Atlanta is in Braselton, Georgia, USA. Its lap is 4.088 km (2.54 miles). It is the home of the Petit Le Mans endurance race. More sim racing guides are on the blog.
